title: A Train Trip Across the Mountains
text:
Last summer, Tom and his sister Ana took a train across the mountains. The train was old and slow, but the views were amazing. At the first station, they bought some bread and cheese and ate them by the window.

On the second day, they got off at a small village by a lake. They rented a boat and rowed to a little island. Ana was afraid of the water at first, but she laughed and enjoyed the trip.

paragraph_translations: No verão passado, Tom e a irmã dele, Ana, pegaram um trem pelas montanhas. O trem era velho e lento, mas as paisagens eram incríveis. Na primeira estação, eles compraram pão e queijo e comeram perto da janela.
No segundo dia, desceram em uma pequena vila à beira de um lago. Eles alugaram um barco e remaram até uma pequena ilha. No início, Ana tinha medo da água, mas ela riu e aproveitou o passeio.
